labels.CONTEXT_DEPENDENT_DEFECT: No material defect is established from source and target alone, but the fixed public-source context establishes a material translation defect.
labels.SURFACE_VISIBLE_DEFECT: A material translation defect is established from source and target alone, and context adds no distinct material defect or material change in scope.
labels.MIXED_DEFECT: A material surface-visible defect and a distinct material context-dependent defect are both present, or context materially changes the nature or scope of the surface-visible defect.
labels.CLEAN: After both passes, no material translation defect is established.
labels.UNRESOLVED: The frozen evidence is insufficient or contradictory, so one or both material axes cannot be determined.

material_axis.surface_material_defect: Whether source and target alone establish a material defect.
material_axis.context_material_contribution: Whether the fixed public-source context establishes a distinct material defect or materially changes the nature or scope of the surface conclusion.
material_axis.material_definition: Material means that the translation can change or materially obscure a player's understanding of a mechanic, action, condition, quantity, polarity, target, scope, timing, causality, speaker, referent or narrative fact. Pure style, fluency or preference differences that preserve substantive meaning are not material.

audit_flow.assignment: The binder assigns each presentation position to shard ((position - 1) mod 3) + 1. Shards are pairwise disjoint and cover all 120 items exactly once.
pass_order: Each worker reviews its 40-item SURFACE queue using only audit_id, source and target.

Each complete SURFACE candidate is parsed against SURFACE-CANDIDATE-SCHEMA.json, checked for the exact 40 ordered audit_ids, and frozen by byte SHA-256 before release-context.mjs can generate that worker's CONTEXT queue.
The same worker then reviews the matching CONTEXT queue with the fixed public-source evidence added. Surface candidates cannot be edited after the context pass begins.
The lead independently verifies all 120 items against the frozen source, target and public-source evidence and issues the final label and material axes.
audit_flow.surface_context_separation: The binder does not generate context queue files. release-context.mjs generates exactly one context shard only after the corresponding complete surface candidate passes exact schema, identity/order and pre-frozen byte-SHA gates. Context or context-derived text must not enter the surface candidate prompt.
audit_flow.lead_responsibility: The lead must inspect every item and may not decide by vote, worker identity or the harsher label.
audit_flow.written_evidence_required: A written material-evidence record is mandatory for every final non-CLEAN label, every surface/context candidate disagreement, every lead override, and every UNRESOLVED axis. The schema also requires a concise lead basis for all 120 items.
audit_flow.replacement_policy: No item replacement after target-bound queue freeze. Missing evidence produces UNRESOLVED or a NO_GO gate, never a hand-selected substitute.

prohibited_inputs: model provenance or model identity as evidence

excluded: any item whose fixed evidence packet is insufficient

selection.method: Select pools strictly in frozen order context, surface, clean. Within each pool, rank tasks by SHA-256(seed NUL pool NUL category NUL task NUL task_id), then visit tasks round-robin; rank rows within task by SHA-256(seed NUL pool NUL row NUL task_id NUL original_revision_key). Satisfy frozen per-category minima first, then fill the remaining pool quota by the same ranks while carrying the global task cap forward from earlier pools.

glm_pilot_gate.no_go: If the determinate threshold, any pool item/task/category minimum, the fixed 8+4+8 composition, packet sufficiency, or the global per-task cap cannot be satisfied, the GLM pilot is NO_GO. Do not relax a threshold or substitute a MIXED or UNRESOLVED item.

route_and_evaluation.arm_B: the same source and target plus the frozen fixed public-source evidence packet
route_and_evaluation.validity_gate: 4/4 runs must parse, cover all 20 ordered items exactly once and pass the frozen output schema; harness failures are not model scores.
route_and_evaluation.atom_hit: For a determinate defect item, a hit requires the candidate to identify the pre-registered material defect atom, not merely emit a generic defect label. For CLEAN, any asserted material defect atom is a false positive.

performance_thresholds.context_cases_arm_B: at least 10/16 atom hits overall and at least 4/8 in each B run
performance_thresholds.context_increment_B_minus_A: at least +4/16 paired atom hits overall and strictly positive in each paired run
performance_thresholds.surface_controls_arm_B: at least 6/8 atom hits overall, with B minus A net loss no worse than -1/8
performance_thresholds.clean_controls_arm_B: at most 2/16 false positives overall and at most 1/8 in each B run
